## Wider Network

Advisory committee members, project partners, and visiting researchers will be added here as they are confirmed. If you are interested in collaborating, please get in touch

### Advisory committee

I am very happy to have a committee of excellent researchers who have managed large projects whose expertise and experience I can draw on at key parts of the project. This is still in development. In alphabetical order:

**Anja Neundorf** (University of Glasgow, ERC Consolidator Grant *DEMED*); **Jennifer Oser** (Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, ERC Starting Grant *PRD*); **Jason Reifler** (University of Southampton, ERC Consolidator Grant *DEBUNKER*); **Tom van der Meer** (University of Amsterdam, ERC Consolidator Grant *CRITICALTRUST*); **Sofia Vasilopoulou** (King's College London, ERC Consolidator Grant *INEQCHANGE*); **Markus Wagner** (University of Vienna, ERC Consolidator Grant *PARTISAN*)

The project is also very happy to be a product of the wider [political trust network](https://www.politicaltrust.eu).
